name: Ghostwise Halfling
description:
Ghostwise Halfling
Ghostwise halflings trace their ancestry back to a war among halfling tribes that sent their ancestors into flight from Luiren. Ghostwise halflings are the rarest of the hin, found only in the Chondalwood and a few other isolated forests, clustered in tight-knit clans.

features.name: Age
features.description: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.

features.name: Size
features.description: Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

features.name: Lucky
features.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Brave
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

features.name: Silent Speech
features.description: You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet of you. The creature understands you only if the two of you share a language. You can speak telepathically in this way to one creature at a time.
